provenance.detail: val-match-v1 requires a Riot production key. Matches here are generated by an in-repo simulator that emits payloads in the documented val-match-v1 shape, grounded in real agent and map UUIDs fetched live from val-content-v1. Nothing is scraped and no unofficial API is used. Every module downstream of the match adapter is source-agnostic, so live data swaps in with no code change.
provenance.note: Simulated data conforming to the val-match-v1 schema — production key application pending
provenance.proxy_note: Momentum index, not a calibrated win probability: a bounded logistic over score state and round spend differential. It ranks rounds against each other within one match and says nothing about the odds of winning.
provenance.sim_approx_note: Kill share stands in for trade efficiency: the simulator emits no death timestamps, so real trade windows cannot be detected.

conclusions.claim: Red went into the pivotal R4 already 2 rounds into a losing streak -- the round that decided the match was played on bonus money.
Red was simply out-fought in the pivotal R4, taking only 25% of the round's kills (sim-approx: kill share stands in for real trade windows).
Red got the spike down but could not hold it -- only 12% of its plants converted into round wins.
Red was out-traded across the match, taking 44% of round kills over 16 rounds against a 50% even split (sim-approx: kill share stands in for real trade windows).
Blue force-bought 3 rounds back to back (R1, R2, R3). One force is a read; a run this long means the team never got off the back foot long enough to rebuild.
Blue force-bought in 9 of 16 rounds (56%), past the 30% mark where forcing stops being a read and starts being a habit.
Red was out-spent by Blue by 1895 credits across the match's 16 rounds -- roughly a third of a full team buy in equipment Red never got to bring.
R4 was the match's pivotal round -- the largest single swing (0.214) in the win-probability proxy. Blue took it, Red lost it.
Blue stole 1 of its 1 eco rounds (100%).
Red stole 0 of its 1 eco rounds (0%).
